changelog: Fix: retention floors could exceed their ceilings (min_file_incr was 40 against a max of 20), which silently stopped UrBackup pruning old backups and let the storage volume fill to 100%. Floors are now realigned and the server rejects any settings save where a min_* is not below its max_* (issue #18)

New: Storage Protection — a disk guard watches free space on the backup volume every 10 minutes and escalates: warn at 75%, alert at 85%, and at 93% it pauses new file and image backups so the volume cannot reach 100%. UrBackup's nightly cleanup reclaims space and backups resume automatically below 70% (issue #18)

New: Settings now has a Storage Protection tab showing live usage against the thresholds, guard event history, and admin actions to reclaim space or prune orphaned files the UrBackup database no longer references

Change: default retention is tighter and now includes explicit floors — 3 full / 20 incremental file backups and 2 full / 10 incremental image backups, with the soft storage quota defaulting to 85% and the cleanup window widened to 1-7am nightly

Fix: the 'no_images' toggle was mislabelled 'Headless Mode (API Only)' — it actually disables image backups server-wide, and is now labelled as such alongside new controls for file backups and the storage soft quota
New: retention floor fields (min full/incremental, file and image) are now editable in Backup Defaults instead of being hidden server-side settings
